pathDecision: Existing driver read and cash-report paths are recorded without renaming; driver contact projection follows the assigned order lifecycle while cash inputs are checked against server ledger facts.

x-recorded-operations.x-contact-projection: pickup.phone and delivery.phone are server-projected: only the assigned driver while assignment.state=accepted and order.state=executing with fulfillmentStage=in_transit receives the complete number; after delivery or cancellation, or for every other client surface, the server returns ******* plus the final four digits. An unassigned driver receives NOT_FOUND.

x-recorded-operations.x-version-resource: body resource versions; create unique aggregate
x-recorded-operations.x-money-source: delivery/insurance amounts and currency are accepted only when they do not exceed server-ledger due amounts for the submitted currency; COD remains disabled unless an authoritative receivable source exists.
